evidence.title: GitHub - LerSent001/orb: Real-time WebGPU liquid-glass orb editor with Web and SwiftUI/Metal export

name: Liquid Orb Editor
summary: Real-time WebGPU liquid-glass orb editor with 13 animated presets and Web/SwiftUI code export.
description: A browser editor for animated liquid-glass orbs built with React, WebGPU/WGSL and Toolcraft UI. Tune color, speed, shape, glass refraction and outer glow across 13 presets, preview the orb alone or in a scene, share configurations through the URL hash, drive the animation with audio, and export standalone Web pages or SwiftUI/Metal code from the same parameter snapshot.
contains: controls for color, speed, shape, glass refraction and outer glow
shareable configurations stored in the URL hash
standalone Web and SwiftUI/Metal code export from one parameter snapshot
audio response from microphone or local audio file, analysed locally in the browser
